calls.statement:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 2 AS period
),
sold_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.sale_date, s.format, f.net_amount
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s     ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p   ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_date d      ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year
      AND d.fiscal_period = params.period
),
refunds AS (
    SELECT sales_line_id, SUM(refund_net) AS refund_net FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT l.format,
       SUM(l.net_amount) AS sold_net,
       COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) AS returned_net,
       ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) / SUM(l.net_amount), 2) AS return_rate_pct,
       MAX(l.sale_date) + 30 <= (SELECT MAX(calendar_date) FROM dim_date) AS cohort_complete
FROM sold_lines l
LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (sales_line_id)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY l.format;

-- Return rate by store format, P2 FY2025/26, with correct web dispatch date handling
WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 2 AS period
),
sold_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.sale_date, s.format, s.store_id, f.net_amount,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', f.sale_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS sale_date_hki
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
sold_with_dates AS (
    -- For stores, use sale_date; for web, use dispatch date
    SELECT sl.sales_line_id, sl.format, sl.net_amount,
           CASE 
             WHEN sl.store_id = 900 THEN CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', wo.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)
             ELSE sl.sale_date
           END AS reporting_date
    FROM sold_lines sl
    LEFT JOIN fact_web_order wo ON wo.web_order_id = sl.sales_line_id AND sl.store_id = 900
),
sold_period AS (
    SELECT sd.sales_line_id, sd.format, sd.net_amount, d.fiscal_period
    FROM sold_with_dates sd
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = sd.reporting_date
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year
      AND d.fiscal_period = params.period
),
refunds AS (
    SELECT sales_line_id, SUM(refund_net) AS refund_net FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT sp.format,
       SUM(sp.net_amount) AS sold_net,
       COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) AS returned_net,
       ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) / SUM(sp.net_amount), 2) AS return_rate_pct,
       MAX(sp.net_amount) > 0 AS has_sales
FROM sold_period sp
LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (sales_line_id)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY sp.format;

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
sold_lines AS (
    -- Store sales on sale_date, web sales on dispatch date
    SELECT f.sales_line_id, 
           COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date,
           f.net_amount,
           cs.format
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_store cs  ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
period_sales AS (
    SELECT sl.sales_line_id, sl.format, sl.net_amount
    FROM sold_lines sl
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = sl.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 2
),
refunds AS (
    SELECT sales_line_id, SUM(refund_net) AS refund_net 
    FROM fact_return_line 
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT ps.format,
       SUM(ps.net_amount) AS sold_net,
       COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) AS returned_net,
       ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) / SUM(ps.net_amount), 2) AS return_rate_pct
FROM period_sales ps
LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (sales_line_id)
GROUP BY ps.format
ORDER BY ps.format;

-- Final query: Return rate by store format, P2 FY2025/26
-- Using dispatch date for web sales, sale date for store sales
WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
sold_lines AS (
    -- Store sales on sale_date, web sales on dispatch date
    SELECT f.sales_line_id, 
           COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date,
           f.net_amount,
           cs.format
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_store cs  ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
period_sales AS (
    SELECT sl.sales_line_id, sl.format, sl.net_amount, sl.business_date
    FROM sold_lines sl
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = sl.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 2
),
refunds AS (
    SELECT sales_line_id, SUM(refund_net) AS refund_net 
    FROM fact_return_line 
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT ps.format,
       SUM(ps.net_amount) AS sold_net,
       COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) AS returned_net,
       ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) / SUM(ps.net_amount), 2) AS return_rate_pct,
       MAX(ps.business_date) + 30 <= (SELECT MAX(calendar_date) FROM dim_date) AS cohort_complete
FROM period_sales ps
LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (sales_line_id)
GROUP BY ps.format
ORDER BY ps.format;
